description: This Java source file contains integration tests for loan application scenarios, specifically testing the undo last disbursal functionality in a loan management system. It includes setup routines, multiple test cases, and utility methods for creating clients, loans, tranches, and verifying loan statuses.

classes.name: LoanApplicationUndoLastTrancheTest
classes.description: Test class containing integration tests for loan disbursal and undo operations in a loan management system.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test setup before each test, configuring REST client and helpers.

methods.name: loanApplicationUndoLastTranche
methods.description: Test case that creates a client and loan with multiple tranches, approves and disburses them, then performs an undo last disbursal and validates the outcome.

methods.name: loanApplicationUndoLastTrancheToClose
methods.description: Test case to verify undo last disbursal in a scenario where the loan is closed or obligations met.

methods.name: loanApplicationUndoLastTrancheWithSameDate
methods.description: Test case that disburses multiple tranches on the same date, then undoes the last disbursal and checks the loan state.

methods.name: validateDisbursedAmount
methods.description: Utility method to assert that a disbursed amount matches the expected value.

methods.name: addCollaterals
methods.description: Utility method to add collateral details to the collaterals list.

methods.name: collaterals
methods.description: Creates a map representing collateral details with collateral id and quantity.

methods.name: applyForLoanApplicationWithTranches
methods.description: Helper method to apply for a loan with specified tranches and collateral details, returning the created loan id.
